# José María Balcázar becomes Peru's eighth president in a decade
LIMA, Peru — Peru's Congress late Wednesday elected legislator José María Balcázar as the country's eighth president in a decade, replacing another interim leader who was ousted the previous day over corruption allegations just four months into his term.
